## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector breadth is mildly positive but mega-cap divergence (MSFT ABOVE TREND vs AAPL/AMD/QCOM BELOW TREND) and concentrated top-performer skew create offsetting signals; Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Consumer Discretionary lead: AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND, BKNG (1W: +8.70% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND. Communication strong: CHTR (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing leaders: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +28.05%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -9.30% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate soft: VTR (1W: -6.98% | 1M: +4.31%) CORRECTION, WELL (1W: -6.99% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION. Industrials pressured: CAT (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -17.66%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -4.86%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND; CHTR (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +3.68%) ABOVE TREND; AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +12.94% | 1M: -8.55%) RECOVERY; ACN (1W: +12.88% | 1M: +28.05%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology) — Style: Growth/Momentum tilt but breadth mixed.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: LIN (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -10.34%) BELOW TREND; VST (1W: -9.30% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND; ASML (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -11.50%) BELOW TREND; CAT (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -17.66%) BELOW TREND; QCOM (1W: -11.59% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Industrials/Select Tech/REITs.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Largest 1W movers: MSFT (1W: +21.75%), CHTR (1W: +17.57%), AMZN (1W: +17.00%), ORCL (1W: +12.94%), ACN (1W: +12.88%) — all showing strong short-term rotation. Major divergence: MSFT surge vs AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION and AMD (1W: -8.77% | 1M: -11.97%) BELOW TREND; treat as tactical, not core.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with narrow leadership: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND and ADBE (1W: +11.24% | 1M: +18.69%) ABOVE TREND outperform while ASML (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -11.50%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.77% | 1M: -11.97%) BELOW TREND and QCOM (1W: -11.59% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND lag; Sector 1W: +2.45% with mixed internal rotation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials constructive but mixed: V (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +4.29%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +6.20% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +5.78%) CORRECTION — sector 1W: +1.10% showing selective strength.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive tone with dispersion: JNJ (1W: -2.68% | 1M: +0.93%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -2.85%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: +1.92% | 1M: +6.56%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W: +0.43% and supported by several bullish catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Given NEUTRAL regime and concentrated leadership, favor participation in confirmed winners (MSFT, ACN, AMZN) while reducing exposure to structurally weak names showing CORRECTION/BELOW TREND (AAPL, AMD, QCOM). Maintain balanced exposure across sectors and treat recent mega-cap rotation as tactical.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND, AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +12.94% | 1M: -8.55%) RECOVERY for follow-through. BEARISH: QCOM (1W: -11.59% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) CORRECTION, AMD (1W: -8.77% | 1M: -11.97%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: +3.85%) and Communication (1W: +2.92%) for momentum continuation. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -4.44%) and Real Estate (1W: -2.33%) for continued pressure.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) — watch hold above this week’s breakout for trend extension. AAPL (1W: -7.24% | 1M: +4.94%) — watch 1M support; failure increases downside risk. NVDA (1W: -2.94% | 1M: +1.60%) CORRECTION — watch whether 1W weakness resolves or broadens. JPM (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +5.78%) CORRECTION — watch reversion to 1M trend.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
BA (+85): BA (1W: +3.16% | 1M: -1.12%) RECOVERY — regulator approval news and price move are confirming. JNJ (+80): JNJ (1W: -2.68% | 1M: +0.93%) CORRECTION — FDA nod but price is drifting lower, a divergence to monitor.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
HD (-40): HD (1W: -0.31% | 1M: -5.38%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines align with price weakness and confirm downside risk. (Other high-sentiment bearish names noted in feeds but lacking dual-timeframe detail here; monitor for follow-through.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. MSFT (1W: +21.75% | 1M: +20.93%) ABOVE TREND and AMZN (1W: +17.00% | 1M: +12.36%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence between MSFT’s surge and broad tech/industrial weakness (AAPL, AMD, QCOM) and mixed sentiment (JNJ bullish but price in CORRECTION) — watch for confirmation.
